title: 新一代人工智能伦理规范

policy_extraction.issuing_body: National New Generation Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional Committee (国家新一代人工智能治理专业委员会), Ministry of Science and Technology of the People's Republic of China
covered_actors: Natural persons engaged in AI management, R&D, supply, or use activities
Legal persons engaged in AI management, R&D, supply, or use activities
Other relevant organizations engaged in AI management, R&D, supply, or use activities
prohibited_practices: Harming individuals' legitimate data rights and interests
Illegally collecting or using personal information through theft, tampering, leakage, or other means
Infringing upon individuals' right to privacy

evidence.quote: （四）确保可控可信。保障人类拥有充分自主决策权，有权选择是否接受人工智能提供的服务，有权随时退出与人工智能的交互，有权随时中止人工智能系统的运行，确保人工智能始终处于人类控制之下。
evidence.quote_en: (4) Ensure controllability and trustworthiness. Safeguard humans' full autonomous decision-making rights, including the right to choose whether to accept services provided by AI, the right to exit interaction with AI at any time, and the right to suspend the operation of AI systems at any time, ensuring that AI always remains under human control.

evidence.quote: 旨在将伦理道德融入人工智能全生命周期，为从事人工智能相关活动的自然人、法人和其他相关机构等提供伦理指引。
evidence.source_section: 《新一代人工智能伦理规范》发布-中华人民共和国科学技术部
evidence.quote_en: aimed at integrating ethics and morality into the entire lifecycle of artificial intelligence, providing ethical guidance for natural persons, legal persons, and other relevant organizations engaged in AI-related activities.

evidence.quote: 在人工智能全生命周期各环节自省自律，建立人工智能问责机制，不回避责任审查，不逃避应负责任。
evidence.quote_en: practice self-reflection and self-discipline across all stages of the AI lifecycle, establish AI accountability mechanisms, and neither evade responsibility reviews nor shirk due responsibilities.

policy_extraction.implementation_notes: Non-binding ethical guideline issued to integrate ethics across the AI lifecycle and operationalize China's New Generation AI Development Plan and Governance Principles. Effective upon publication (2021-09-25) and subject to timely revision based on socioeconomic needs and AI development. Note that the provided text contains the release notice, Articles 2-3, and Article 25, while the 18 specific ethical requirements for management, R&D, supply, and use referenced in the preamble are omitted from this excerpt.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document's dominant rationale is fundamental_rights, as both its introductory framing and core principles explicitly anchor ethical AI governance in protecting personal privacy, data rights, informed consent, human rights, fairness, non-discrimination, equal opportunity, and human autonomous decision-making. Innovation_enablement and social_stability serve as prominent secondary frames: the purpose clause justifies the norms as guiding responsible AI R&D and application to promote healthy AI development, while Article 3(1) invokes public interest, national/regional ethical norms, human-machine harmony, and social livelihoods. Fundamental_rights edges out these secondary frames because the majority of the substantive ethical principles (fairness, privacy/data rights, human rights, and user autonomy) center directly on individual rights and anti-discrimination. Consumer_public_safety plays a smaller supporting role through user-facing controllability, system-termination safeguards, and protection of vulnerable groups.

evidence_spans.quote: 充分考虑当前社会各界有关隐私、偏见、歧视、公平等伦理关切
evidence_spans.source_section: 《新一代人工智能伦理规范》发布-中华人民共和国科学技术部
evidence_spans.quote_en: fully takes into account current ethical concerns from all sectors of society regarding privacy, bias, discrimination, and fairness

evidence_spans.quote: 充分尊重个人信息知情、同意等权利，依照合法、正当、必要和诚信原则处理个人信息，保障个人隐私与数据安全，不得损害个人合法数据权益，不得以窃取、篡改、泄露等方式非法收集利用个人信息，不得侵害个人隐私权。
evidence_spans.quote_en: Fully respect personal information rights such as informed notice and consent, process personal information in accordance with the principles of legality, legitimacy, necessity, and good faith, safeguard personal privacy and data security, must not harm individuals' lawful data rights and interests, must not illegally collect or use personal information through theft, tampering, or leakage, and must not infringe upon personal privacy rights.

evidence_spans.quote: 增强全社会的人工智能伦理意识与行为自觉，积极引导负责任的人工智能研发与应用活动，促进人工智能健康发展，制定本规范。
evidence_spans.source_section: 《新一代人工智能伦理规范》发布-中华人民共和国科学技术部
evidence_spans.quote_en: to strengthen AI ethical awareness and behavioral self-discipline across the whole society, actively guide responsible AI R&D and application activities, and promote the healthy development of AI, these Norms are formulated.

evidence_spans.quote: 坚持以人为本，遵循人类共同价值观，尊重人权和人类根本利益诉求，遵守国家或地区伦理道德。坚持公共利益优先，促进人机和谐友好，改善民生，增强获得感幸福感，推动经济、社会及生态可持续发展，共建人类命运共同体。
evidence_spans.quote_en: Adhere to a people-centered approach, follow common human values, respect human rights and fundamental human interests, and comply with national or regional ethics and morality. Uphold the priority of public interest, promote harmonious and friendly human-machine relations, improve people's livelihoods, enhance their sense of gain and happiness, promote sustainable economic, social, and ecological development, and jointly build a community with a shared future for mankind.

evidence_spans.quote: 保障人类拥有充分自主决策权，有权选择是否接受人工智能提供的服务，有权随时退出与人工智能的交互，有权随时中止人工智能系统的运行，确保人工智能始终处于人类控制之下。
evidence_spans.quote_en: Ensure that humans have full autonomous decision-making authority, the right to choose whether to accept services provided by AI, the right to exit interaction with AI at any time, and the right to terminate the operation of AI systems at any time, ensuring that AI always remains under human control.
